summary.intent: Resolve PR review comments on a load testing branch, investigate a throttle bypass gap, and complete the refactor of api-client from a module-level singleton to instance-scoped axios per CipherBoxClient.
summary.outcome: All PR review threads resolved (17 total across multiple passes), the singleton axios pattern fully eliminated in favor of a single shared instance owned by api-config.ts and threaded through CipherBoxClient, and all sdk-core operations (including IPFS) migrated to use the instance-scoped axios.

repo: The web app calls generated API functions directly (not through CipherBoxClient) for auth, vault init, shares, device approval, health — these 13 files were the last consumers of the singleton axios pattern.

Phase 19.1 was marked complete in the roadmap but the web app migration (Plan 19.1-05) was only partial — core CRUD operations were rewired but auth/shares/invites/device-approval remained on the singleton path.

BypassableThrottlerGuard.canActivate() returns true before super.canActivate(), so per-endpoint @Throttle decorators are never consulted when the bypass header is present — the bypass works correctly at the NestJS layer.
The IPFS controller uses only JwtAuthGuard with no throttle guard, so IPFS operations are not rate-limited by the API layer.
sdk-core's addToIpfs/unpinFromIpfs used bare axios.post() with manual token injection instead of the instance-scoped axios, meaning they missed 401 refresh handling.
Integration tests that hit the live API produce 429s when multiple test suites run in parallel due to shared API load, not a code bug — tests pass when run in isolation.

code.finding: customInstance now accepts optional _axiosInstance in options to bypass singleton; setApiClientConfig accepts a pre-built instance; getCachedInstance uses createAxiosInstance with 401 refresh support
SdkContext gained optional axiosInstance field; AxiosInstance type imported from @cipherbox/api-client re-export rather than axios directly since sdk-core doesn't depend on axios
CipherBoxClientConfig gained optional axiosInstance and defaultHeaders fields; same AxiosInstance import pattern from api-client
CipherBoxClient constructor uses provided axiosInstance or creates its own via createAxiosInstance(); instance is included in SdkContext so all sdk-core operations use it
Creates the single shared axios instance with auth + 401 refresh, registers it as singleton via setApiClientConfig, and exports it for use by CipherBoxClient
initSdkClient now passes the shared axios instance from api-config to CipherBoxClient so both code paths use the same instance
addToIpfs and unpinFromIpfs migrated from bare axios.post() with manual Authorization header to ctx.axiosInstance for consistency and 401 refresh support
loadBinMetadataInternal and saveBinMetadata were missing ctx threading to IPNS calls; fixed to pass ctx so they use the instance-scoped axios
switchTo() method entirely removed — no longer needed since each CipherBoxClient has its own axios instance with its own auth headers

setApiClientConfig call removed; each client created with defaultHeaders for bypass; destroyClientPool now zeros caller-owned key material after client.destroy() and logs errors instead of silently swallowing them
Mock assertions needed updating after ctx parameter was added to IPNS functions — now expects (data, undefined) call signature
setApiClientConfig call removed; client now created with defaultHeaders directly in CipherBoxClientConfig

workflow: When making instance.ts changes that affect both singleton and instance paths, run api-client unit tests specifically to verify backward compat before running the full suite.
TypeScript dynamic import() for types from packages not in direct dependencies fails at typecheck — use re-exports from packages that are in the dependency graph instead.

Parallel test suite execution against a live API will produce transient 429s regardless of bypass headers — always verify test failures by running the affected package in isolation before concluding it's a code issue.
curl -s silently returns exit 0 on HTTP 5xx; use curl -fsS in CI health check loops to correctly fail on server errors.
When GitHub Copilot review comments reference singleton patterns that were addressed in a prior commit, reply with the specific commit hash and what was changed for traceability before resolving.

friction: Multiple rounds of PR review comment resolution were needed (4 separate /resolve-pr-comments invocations) because new automated review comments appeared after each push.
The ipns.test.ts mock assertions broke silently after adding the ctx parameter — type system didn't catch the argument count mismatch because the mock accepts any args.
sdk-core cannot import AxiosInstance from 'axios' directly even though axios is a transitive dependency — required using the re-export from @cipherbox/api-client, which is a non-obvious indirection.
The bin/index.ts IPNS calls were missed in the initial threading pass and only caught by a grep scan after the first typecheck passed — suggesting the grep should have been done proactively.
Integration test 429s from parallel execution were initially suspected as code regressions, causing extra investigation and cooldown-retry cycles.
open_items: 13 web app files still import directly from @cipherbox/api-client (auth, vault init, shares, invites, device approval, health, IPFS, IPNS hooks) — these should eventually be migrated to go through CipherBoxClient per Phase 19.1-05, at which point setApiClientConfig and the singleton can be fully deleted.

fetchFromIpfs uses native fetch() for streaming instead of the instance-scoped axios — not a correctness issue since it doesn't need auth headers, but noted as the one remaining non-instance call path in sdk-core.
The load test 429s from parallel test suite execution against the live API remain a known issue — a test parallelism strategy or per-suite rate limit headroom may be needed for CI reliability.
ROADMAP.md Phase 19.1 checkbox states do not reflect actual completion status — the checkboxes are unchecked despite the phase being described as complete.
